title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 18: the share of the priests and Levites, forbidden practices, and the promised prophet.

questions.text: According to verse 2, what is the inheritance of the Levites?
questions.explanation: The Levites have no inheritance among their brothers: Yahweh is their inheritance.

answers.text: Yahweh himself
The cities of refuge
The land east of the Jordan
A double portion of the land

questions.text: Which parts of an ox or sheep were to be given to the priest?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says the priests' due is the shoulder, the two cheeks and the inner parts.

answers.text: The head, the hooves and the tail
The shoulder, the two cheeks and the inner parts
The skin and all of the fat
The whole animal, burned on the altar

questions.text: Besides grain, new wine and oil, what first portion was to be given to the priest?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 lists the first fruits of grain, new wine and oil, and the first of the fleece of the sheep.

answers.text: The first of the fleece of the sheep
The first of the honey from the hills
The first of the figs and dates
The firstborn of every donkey

questions.text: Which practice involving children does verse 10 forbid?
questions.explanation: There was not to be anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire.

answers.text: Teaching them to work in the fields
Giving them the names of foreign kings
Making a son or daughter pass through the fire
Sending them to live with their uncles

questions.text: Why was Yahweh driving out the nations before Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you."

answers.text: Because they had no king
Because of their abominations
Because they refused to trade with Israel
Because their land was too small

questions.text: Whom did Moses say Yahweh would raise up for Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says Yahweh would raise up a prophet from among them, of their brothers, like Moses, and they were to listen to him.

answers.text: A king like the kings of the nations
A priest from the land of Egypt
A judge from among the foreigners
A prophet like Moses, from among their brothers

questions.text: Where had the people asked not to hear Yahweh's voice again?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says they desired this in Horeb in the day of the assembly.

answers.text: In Horeb
At Kadesh
At Mount Gerizim
At Gilgal

questions.text: What did the people at the assembly not want to see any more?
questions.explanation: They said: "Let me not hear again Yahweh my God's voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die."

answers.text: The cloud over the tent
The sea split in two
The pillar of salt
This great fire

questions.text: What would happen to a prophet who spoke in Yahweh's name what Yahweh had not commanded?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says the prophet who speaks presumptuously in Yahweh's name, or in the name of other gods, shall die.

answers.text: He would be made a Levite
That prophet would die
He would be sent back to Egypt
He would lose his house

questions.text: How could the people know that a prophet's word was not spoken by Yahweh?
questions.explanation: If the thing a prophet speaks in Yahweh's name does not follow or happen, Yahweh has not spoken it; the prophet spoke presumptuously.

answers.text: He did not wear a prophet's cloak
He spoke only at night
The thing he said did not happen
He came from another tribe
